items.setting: A second region handling reversible routine repairs
items.text: Teams used the dashboard to reserve crews provisionally before approval. Median resolution time fell, and managers approved 31 of 32 proposed reallocations without modification.

items.setting: Hazardous-material incidents with irreversible safety consequences
items.text: Dispatchers did not make provisional commitments. They waited for a central safety officer to select and authorize the receiving crew, and response time did not improve.

items.setting: A region with incomplete dashboard updates
items.text: Lateral reservations frequently failed because displayed crew availability was stale. Managers resumed assembling reallocations centrally until data quality improved.
Incident severity and staffing levels were similar across the focal pre- and post-implementation periods, although the synthetic packet cannot rule out every time-varying alternative.
